objective: Capture the identity-free runtime feature vectors seen by the exact FSHC gate on the frozen development replay frame.
hypothesis: The exact FSHC zero-dose path emits finite fixed-shape runtime features for every denoising invocation without changing the baseline outcome.
selection_reason: The direction atlas contains context labels but the runtime gate cannot consume context identity. A separately hashed anonymous feature bank is required to supervise the gate without broadcasting one context label to all training windows.
falsification_criterion: The capture is invalid if any identity, invocation, runtime feature, zero-dose equality, source hash, or physical GPU receipt is missing or non-finite.

probe_paths.transformation: apply fixed gain d through the exact norm-bounded FSHC operator and record its pre-gate runtime feature

artifact_policy: Retain all identity shards and logs for audit, but emit a separate training payload containing only runtime feature tensors and signed or abstain targets.
claim_scope: Feature capture only. It introduces no new effect estimate, direction decision, or model improvement claim.
formal_next_gate: Materialize an anonymous hash-bound feature bank and pass gate overfit, leakage, gradient, and counterfactual tests.
